# Operations Performance and Cash Flow Review

This document details critical operational tasks and investigations:

*   Investigate the cash flow quarterly.
*   Investigate the customer wait time urgently.
*   Monitor the teller performance urgently.
*   Optimize the teller performance standard update.
*   Monitor the customer wait time based on audit.
